records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] The plural hydration branch in store.js crashes on a null *_ids key (TypeError when serializer emits null ids for empty associations) and the || [] fallback is dead code, leaving undefined entries from failed _lookupSubType
records.rationale: In `store.js.es6`, the new plural branch matches keys like `*_ids` and does `const hydrated = obj[k].map(function(id) { ... })` without guarding for `obj[k]` being `null`/`undefined` (would throw `TypeError: Cannot read property 'map' of null`). Also, `obj[self.pluralize(subType)] = hydrated || []` is effectively dead as a fallback because `map` returns an Array (truthy) and will not convert lookup failures to `[]`; instead it can produce arrays containing `undefined`/`null` when `_lookupSubType` fails.

records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] EmbeddableHost validation regex requires a lettered TLD (\.[a-z]{2,5}), rejecting localhost, IP addresses, and long or hyphenated TLDs with a generic format error
records.rationale: `EmbeddableHost` enforces `validates_format_of :host` with `/\A[a-z0-9]+([\-\.]{1}[a-z0-9]+)*\.[a-z]{2,5}(:[0-9]{1,5})?(\/.*)?\Z/i` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb), which hard-requires a dot plus a 2–5 letter TLD. This will reject valid/previously-allowed hosts like `localhost` (no dot), IP literals (TLD must be letters), and real long TLDs (e.g. `.museum`, `.technology`) or other non-matching cases, producing a generic “format” validation failure in the admin UI.
